records.name: Sovereign Powers 1592 Cifrari
records.additional_information:
The image is not in the public domain. Publishing it is only possible with the permission of the archive.

(Satoshi Tomokiyo, 8-11 May 2024) The pieces of most of the images are identical with those from Carteggio Sforzesco 1597 (DECODE R5301-5473). Specifically,
p3 is identical with R5302;
p4 is identical with R5305;
p5 is identical with R5307;
p7 is identical with R5304;
p9 is identical with R5308;
p13 is identical with R5310;
p14 is identical with R5309;
p16 is identical with R5311;
p15 is identical with R5314:
p17 is identical with R5323;
p19 is identical with R5350;
p20 is identical with R5358;
p22 is identical with R5359;
p23 is identical with R5364; and
p24 is identical with R5378.

The image of p.11 (I8464) is the cipher used in BnF it. 1584, f.69.

 

I have not been able to locate p2, p11, and p18.
